# Vim Canvas™️

Access to EHR workflows at scale.Proven user experience.Intelligent actions.

Start building your application on top of Vim’s proven in-EHR connectivity layer. Here you can learn more about our middleware platform for healthcare, see Vim OS SDK's documentation, and gain access to Vim’s custom EHR sandbox environment.

[Getting started](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/setting-up)

![](https://docs.getvim.com/images/sdkDocsHero.gif)

![](https://docs.getvim.com/images/features/Dev.png)

## Build

Start creating - set up your app branding, leverage Vim platform engagement features and define the EHR read & write workflow resources to use.

![](https://docs.getvim.com/images/features/SDK.png)

## Integrate the VimOS.js

Integrate Vim Canvas™️ SDK into your code base to interact with EHR systems through Vim Connect, harnessing real-time updates and taking EHR state management to the next level.

![](https://docs.getvim.com/images/features/simulator.png)

## Test

Leverage Vim’s sandbox and simulator EHR to experiment with confidence and polish the end user experience.

![](https://docs.getvim.com/images/features/bolt.png)

## Deliver

Submit your application for review and roll it out to your selected provider network, once ready.
